Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for prod-inference-latency-high (PD-INC-8421) at 2026-03-15T05:12:12Z
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation policy 'infra-critical' triggered. Primary: Maya (oncall) -> Secondary: Liam R. -> Manager: Olivia S. (page fired). Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-8421
Maya (oncall): ack'ing now, on commute, will check console in 5-10m
PagerDuty Bot: Maya (oncall) acknowledged incident PD-INC-8421 at 2026-03-15T05:12:45Z :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): hmm getting a mobile DND bounce? my phone showed muted, repeating the ack in slack in case mobile missed it
Maya (oncall): checking inference fleet metrics: p50 latency spike visible in us-west-2. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/inference/latency
Jordan (sre): I can look at the KG cache nodes, paging into the bridge if needed. quick question — are we seeing increased qps or just tail latency?
Maya (oncall): looks like tail, qps normal. some failed RPCs: 503 from transformer-01 cluster logs:
```
2026-03-15T05:11:58Z transformer-01: rpc failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T05:12:02Z transformer-02: kv cache miss spike: 87%
```
Liam R.: (secondary) I didn't get the initial page — my PD mobile was on DND. got escalated to me ~20s ago, trying to ack now
PagerDuty Bot: Liam R. attempted ack but PD shows no response (mobile DND). Manager escalation to Olivia S. firing in 45s.
Olivia S.: on laptop, seeing escalated page. joining bridge in 2. if primary/secondary offline, I can run immediate failover
Maya (oncall): weird — I did ack but PD shows me as acknowledged then auto-unacked? re-checking PD audit log.
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty audit: Maya (oncall) acknowledged at 05:12:45, then escalation rule retried after missed heartbeat; acknowledgement not refreshed — PD routed to secondary. (PD-audit-id: a7c2f1)
Jordan (sre): this smells like PD duplicate binding + our oncall mobile app glitch. but primary still has console access? Maya, can you run the quick probe script in cluster? `scripts/prod/check_inference_nodes.sh --cluster us-west-2`
Maya (oncall): running now, pasting output:
```
> check_inference_nodes.sh --cluster us-west-2
node transformer-01: 200ms p95, 503 spikes on rpc
node transformer-02: 350ms p95, kv-cache-evictions high
node transformer-03: healthy
```
Liam R.: I can swap traffic to transformer-03 pool if Maya wants me to. I have a partial route ready: `kubectl patch svc inference --patch '{"spec": {"selector": {"pool": "transformer-03"}}}'` — but that's blunt. recommend throttling heavy customers first.
Maya (oncall): agree throttle heavy customers. Jordan, can you add a temporary rate-limit key for partner X?
Jordan (sre): doing it now. adding a 50% rate-limit for partner-x token in gateway.
PagerDuty Bot: Escalation to Olivia S. timed out after 60s (no ack). Manager escalation rerouted to oncall-following team.
Olivia S.: I got the page but was on a video call for 30s and missed the initial ack window, joining now. I see Maya and Liam already coordinating — thanks.
Maya (oncall): traffic throttling applied by Jordan. initial tail latency dropping on transformer-02 from 350ms -> 200ms p95. still some 503s.
Liam R.: I am starting a targeted failover for the KV-cacher on transformer-02 to clear evicted entries: `k8s rollout restart ds/kv-cache-transformer-02 -n inference`
Maya (oncall): doing a graceful reroute for customer-heavy routing rules: `trafficctl reroute --pool transformer-03 --percent 30 --customer partner-x`
Liam R.: reroute done, restart started. will watch logs for reconnect storms.
PagerDuty Bot: PD-INC-8421 notes: secondary attempted ack, manager attempted ack, auto-escalation ran. No PD policy misfire found but several delayed ack events due to mobile DNDs.
Jordan (sre): quick check — are we seeing any customer-facing 5xx errors? Support Slack channel shows one ticket: ticket #SUP-9912 reported latency but not errors. CS says some customers saw 504s earlier.
Maya (oncall): per gateway logs, 504 rate peaked 05:11-05:13 UTC and is now falling. current error rate < 0.5%
Olivia S.: I'll tell sales/support on the bridge: short-lived latency spike, partial throttling applied, targeted restart triggered, no major customer data impact. patch message: "We observed a transient inference latency spike impacting some customers; our infra team applied mitigations and service is returning to normal. We're monitoring."
Liam R.: restart finished, transformer-02 kv-cache pod restarted and rewarms. p50/p95 trending down.
Maya (oncall): marking incident as handoff-ready. I'm going to sleep on-call shift in 10m — Jordan will take primary watch. Jordan, can you monitor for the next 2 hours and open a follow-up ticket to investigate PD mobile ack discrepancy?
Jordan (sre): yes, I'll monitor dashboards and open an internal ticket: INFRA-4236 (investigate PD mobile/ack race).
PagerDuty Bot: Incident PD-INC-8421 auto-resolved at 2026-03-15T05:17:32Z :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): thanks all. action items: Jordan->INFRA-4236 (PD mobile/dnd), Liam->INFRA-4237 (kv-cache eviction pacing), Maya->post-incident note for runbook gap.
Olivia S.: filing short customer postmortem for support. will include timeline and tickets.
Jordan (sre): added logs + timestamps to INFRA-4236 and attached PD-audit dump. will also add a note about escalation policy timings.
Maya (oncall): closing thread, ping me if it flares again. :thumbsup:
